newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel says ahead of target.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says ahead of target.

text.p: The executive chairman of Eurotunnel said the Channel tunnel operator is ahead of the highest projections published in its debt restructuring prospectus in May and is on course to meet its goals for 1997.

"As far as our activities overall are concerned, I am able to announce today that we will be ahead of our highest projections in the first half," Patrick Ponsolle told Les Echos in an interview to be published on Tuesday.
"I am very confident therefore of our ability to reach the high end figures laid out in this scenario for 1997," he said.
Eurotunnel said in the prospectus for its April debt plan -- up for shareholder approval next month -- that it hoped to show a net profit in 2005 and pay a dividend the next year.
